summary: XP progress toward the next level, composed using the existing Progress component.
whenToUse: Showing current XP, threshold, and current level in a profile or community area.
whenNotToUse: Displaying circular goals or KPI cards: use GoalCard.
Calculating XP or levels on the application side.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible and accessible name of the progress.

props.name: targetXp
props.description: XP required for the next level.

props.name: level
props.description: Current level shown above the bar.

accessibility: Reuses Progress for the progressbar role, accessible name, and values.
The displayed value is text, formatted according to the active locale.
responsive: The linear bar adapts to the available width.
customization: The bar is the shared Progress; the container uses --dc-* tokens and accepts className.
commonMistakes: Passing XP as a percentage: currentXp and targetXp are absolute values.
limits: Does not calculate XP awards or level progression.
